messages:
Maria: Heads upI've uploaded the launch blog draft (v4) to Drive and pinned it. Need a fast editorial + legal sweep before we queue publish. Can folks skim and flag anything that reads like a promise? :wave:
Aj: on it. I'll look at CTAs and the webhook for demo routing. Thinking webinar first, then explicit demo CTA in follow-up email — better for capture. @Leo any constraints for demo ops?
Tom: pushed two hero options into the folder: hero_still_A.png and hero_motion_B.mp4. My vote is motion_B for launch social but still_A for blog header if we care about payload.
Sasha: quick legal note two lines in the product claims section are borderline guarantees. I'll propose softer phrasing now. Also avoid numeric uptime claims without evidence.
Leo: demo ops: we can support 3 webinar cohorts the week after launch and 2 live demo slots/day. Recommend webinar -> nurture -> 1:1 demo so AE capacity doesn't spike. We need the lead tag: "launch_post_webinar" for SFDC routing.
Aj: I'll wire the webhook to the marketing lead queue and include that tag. Test payload posted below for QA: `{
  "source": "launch_blog_v4",
  "tags": ["launch_post_webinar"],
  "email": "qa+webhook@redwood.ai"
}`
Maria: I updated the CTAs to webinar-first and added a short follow-up email teaser. Also set tentative publish window: 2024-05-10 09:00 PT. If we need APAC reach, we can shift to 11:00 PT. Thoughts?
Tom: 09:00 PT ok. I'll export hero_still_A @2x and drop in assets folder by 2pm PT.
Sasha: suggested phrasing in comments: replace "guarantees" with "aims to" or "designed to". Removed direct numeric claims.
Aj: webhook is live to sandbox and sent a test; SFDC mapping looks good. Will flip to prod after Maria approves final copy.
Leo: calendar for demo slots created: https://cal.re/postlaunch-demo. AEs assigned to queue. Confirmed webinar capacity: 3 cohorts (AM/Noon/PM PT).
Maria: great. Final actions in the doc checklist:
- Sasha: finalize legal language (deadline 5pm PT)
- Aj: switch webhook to prod and confirm SFDC tag mapping
- Tom: deliver hero_still_A export to /assets by 14:00 PT
- Leo: confirm AE handoff and calendar link finalize
- Maria: queue post in CMS and set publish time 2024-05-10 09:00 PT

PublishBot: Publish job created: id=pub-20240510-002, scheduled 2024-05-10 09:00 PT. Pinged ops for CDN prewarm.
Maria: thanks team. I'll do a final pass after Sasha's legal line clears and then hit publish queue. :rocket:
